description: Fix 'new kube context needs full app reload'. Root cause: K8sService.getClusters()/hasContext() read a cached KubeConfig (this.kc) that is only reloaded on context switch / 10 min / 401, and the renderer fetches the list only on mount / sidebar mode change. Also settings_kubeconfigPath is stored but never honored by K8sService. Add a main-process kubeconfig watcher, make getClusters/hasContext self-refreshing, emit k8s:contextsChanged to the renderer, and share one cluster list via a hook. Independent of rename logic but FEAT-002 builds on its files and IPC wiring.
steps: Create /Users/MohammedRashid.Matin/Development/lumen/src/types/cluster-context.ts exporting ClusterContextInfo {name; cluster: string; user: string; namespace?: string}, ContextsChangedPayload {contexts: ClusterContextInfo[]; added: string[]; removed: string[]} and RenameClusterResult (discriminated: {ok:true; newName; clusters; pinnedClusters} | {ok:false; error}) (used by FEAT-002 too).

Create electron/kubeconfig-files.ts (no electron imports): resolveKubeconfigFiles({customPath, env, homedir, delimiter, exists}) (trim, expand leading ~, custom path only if it exists, else KUBECONFIG split by path.delimiter, else ~/.kube/config), hashKubeconfigFiles(files) (sha1 over path + content or 'missing'), contextsSignature(contexts).

Create electron/kubeconfig-watcher.ts: class KubeconfigWatcher(onChange, {intervalMs:1000, debounceMs:400}) using fs.watchFile(file, {interval, persistent:false}, listener) with stored per-file listeners; setFiles(files) unwatches only its own listeners via unwatchFile(file, listener) then watches the new list; stop() clears watchers and debounce timer. Trigger on mtime/size/ino change including file appear/disappear. Comment why watchFile (path polling survives atomic-rename replacement).

Edit electron/k8s.ts: constructor(customKubeconfigPath?: string); add private loadKubeConfig() (loadFromFile(custom) when resolved custom path is used, else loadFromDefault) and use it in the constructor and reloadKubeConfig(); track kubeconfigHash and contextsSig; add setKubeconfigPath(p?: string) (store, force refresh), getKubeconfigFiles(), getCustomKubeconfigPath(), onKubeconfigChanged(cb) returning an unsubscribe, and refreshKubeConfig({force?, silent?}): compare hash (no-op if same unless force), load a new KubeConfig inside try/catch (keep old config on parse error), clearExecTokenCache on the old one, re-apply this.currentContext to the new kc when it still exists, swap this.kc, update lastReloadTime/hash/signature, compute added/removed, if the ACTIVE context was removed call stopAllWatchers() and reset currentContext, emit {contexts, added, removed} to listeners unless silent or the list signature is unchanged. Change getClusters() to call refreshKubeConfig() first and return ClusterContextInfo[] (include namespace); change hasContext() to refresh and re-check on a miss. Do not disturb watchers otherwise.

Edit electron/main.ts: `new K8sService((store.get('settings_kubeconfigPath') as string) || undefined)`; create KubeconfigWatcher calling k8sService.refreshKubeConfig(), setFiles(k8sService.getKubeconfigFiles()); register k8sService.onKubeconfigChanged to send 'k8s:contextsChanged' via `win && !win.isDestroyed()`; call watcher.stop() in the app 'before-quit' handler; in settings:setKubeconfigPath call k8sService.setKubeconfigPath(value.trim() || undefined) then watcher.setFiles(k8sService.getKubeconfigFiles()); in 'start-pod-informer' include kubeconfigPath: k8sService.getCustomKubeconfigPath() in the worker message.

Edit electron/preload.ts: add onContextsChanged(callback) { const listener = (_e, payload) => callback(payload); ipcRenderer.on('k8s:contextsChanged', listener); return () => ipcRenderer.off('k8s:contextsChanged', listener); }. Update typings in electron/electron-env.d.ts and src/vite-env.d.ts (getClusters -> Promise<ClusterContextInfo[]>, onContextsChanged). Fix any tsc fallout from tightening getClusters.

Create src/hooks/useClusterContexts.ts returning {clusters, refresh, applyClusters}: initial window.k8s.getClusters(), subscribe via window.k8s.onContextsChanged (cleanup returns the unsubscribe), DOM window 'focus' listener with >=2s throttle calling refresh, state only replaced when contextsSignature-like comparison (name/cluster/user/namespace) differs, optional onChanged callback held in a ref. Do NOT use window.k8s.app.onWindowFocused (it uses removeAllListeners).

Edit src/App.tsx: replace the clustersList state and its mount effect (~78, ~127) with the hook; on a change payload whose `removed` includes the selected cluster, showToast warning/info, setSelectedCluster(null), setActiveView('clusters'); pass `clusters` to SecondarySidebar and StatusBar. Edit SecondarySidebar.tsx: accept a `clusters` prop (typed ClusterContextInfo[]) and delete its own `clusters` state and getClusters effect (~204-211).
acceptance_criteria: Adding a context to the kubeconfig file while the app is running updates the cluster list (sidebar, status bar picker) without reload within ~2s, including when the file is replaced via write-temp-then-rename
Fetching the cluster list (getClusters) after an external edit returns the new context even if the watcher has not fired
Connected-cluster watchers keep running when unrelated contexts are added/removed; they are stopped only if the active context was removed, and the user is returned to the cluster list with a toast
settings_kubeconfigPath is honored by K8sService (and pod worker) and the watcher re-points when it changes; watcher is stopped on app quit
onContextsChanged unsubscribe removes only its own listener
No throwaway/test files left in the repo
verification: npx eslint on each touched/new file; no new errors on lines written

Throwaway vitest (delete after): temp dir kubeconfig; KubeconfigWatcher fires once after appending a context and once after an atomic write-temp+rename replacement, not for an identical-content rewrite; resolveKubeconfigFiles handles custom path, ~ expansion, KUBECONFIG multi-path, default
findings: Implemented and verified (tsc clean; eslint clean on new files, only pre-existing no-explicit-any in k8s.ts; throwaway vitest 3/3 passed against temp-dir kubeconfigs and was deleted). Nothing committed. EXPORTS FOR FEAT-002: src/types/cluster-context.ts exports ClusterContextInfo, ContextsChangedPayload, RenameClusterResult (already defined). electron/kubeconfig-files.ts exports resolveKubeconfigFiles(opts), resolveCustomKubeconfigPath(customPath, homedir, exists?), hashKubeconfigFiles(files), contextsSignature(contexts) (extend this file with renameContextInFiles; opts.env is Record<string,string|undefined> because the project augments NodeJS.ProcessEnv with required APP_ROOT/VITE_PUBLIC). electron/kubeconfig-watcher.ts exports class KubeconfigWatcher(onChange, {intervalMs, debounceMs}) with setFiles(files)/stop(). K8sService (electron/k8s.ts) now has: constructor(customKubeconfigPath?: string); public getKubeconfigFiles(): string[] (use these paths for the rename: custom path if it exists, else KUBECONFIG split, else ~/.kube/config); public getCustomKubeconfigPath(): string|undefined; public setKubeconfigPath(p?: string); public onKubeconfigChanged(cb: (p: ContextsChangedPayload)=>void): ()=>void; public refreshKubeConfig(opts?: {force?: boolean; silent?: boolean}): void (returns void; hash-checks, keeps old config on parse error, re-applies this.currentContext, calls stopAllWatchers() + resets currentContext='' only if the active context was removed, emits only if the contexts signature changed and not silent); getClusters(): ClusterContextInfo[] (refreshes first); hasContext(name) (refreshes on a miss); private toClusterInfo(kc) maps contexts (private; renameContext should return this.getClusters() after refreshKubeConfig({force:true, silent:true}) - getClusters() will then be a no-op refresh and return the fresh list). Private fields available in the class: currentContext, resourcePluralCache, kubeconfigHash, contextsSig, contextNames. NOTE for rename: because refreshKubeConfig({force:true,silent:true}) re-applies this.currentContext only if it still exists, update this.currentContext to the new name BEFORE calling it (and call stopAllWatchers()) when the old name was active, otherwise it is treated as 'active removed' (watchers stopped, currentContext reset - which is acceptable but would also trigger stopAllWatchers a second time). Also createContextKubeConfig() and reloadKubeConfig() now use the private loadKubeConfig() (custom path honored). main.ts: module-level `kubeconfigWatcher` (KubeconfigWatcher) and the `k8s:contextsChanged` forwarder are set up right after `const k8sService = new K8sService(...)`; settings:setKubeconfigPath re-points both. preload.ts/electron-env.d.ts/src/vite-env.d.ts: getClusters now typed Promise<ClusterContextInfo[]>, added onContextsChanged(cb)=>unsubscribe (uses ipcRenderer.off). Renderer: src/hooks/useClusterContexts.ts exports useClusterContexts(onChanged?: (payload: ContextsChangedPayload)=>void) returning {clusters, refresh, applyClusters(next: ClusterContextInfo[])} (applyClusters only updates state if the name/cluster/user/namespace signature differs; call it with RenameClusterResult.clusters). In App.tsx the hook result is `const { clusters: clustersList } = useClusterContexts(...)` near line 78 (destructure applyClusters there too for FEAT-002); the onChanged callback closes over latest selectedCluster (stored in a ref by the hook), uses showToastRef.current (declared later in App) and on removal of selectedCluster toasts 'info', setSelectedCluster(null), setActiveView('clusters'). SecondarySidebar.tsx now takes a `clusters?: ClusterContextInfo[]` prop (default []), its local clusters state and getClusters effect were removed; App passes clusters={clustersList}. StatusBar receives clusters={clustersList}. The toast container z-index change (z-[100] -> z-[300]) and handleRenameCluster are still FEAT-002's job. Pod worker start-informer message now carries kubeconfigPath: k8sService.getCustomKubeconfigPath().
